verdict.rationale: Porkbun publishes machine-readable LLM-oriented docs (llms.txt, llms-full.txt) that describe endpoints and exact response shapes with zero setup, which is a step toward an 'equivalent' machine-readable spec, but a direct probe found no actual OpenAPI/Swagger file at any standard location. Missing for 10: a real OpenAPI/Swagger JSON/YAML spec or confirmed structured schema format, independent corroboration that llms.txt is usable as a programmatic API spec (e.g., for codegen).
